## Active package

**R0-JOURNAL-LIFECYCLE** — The complete manual journal vertical: balanced posting API (single point of ledger truth), draft workspace, on-demand validation sharing one rule source with posting, direct-post, JE view with reversal linkage, posted-JE reversal, and draft void. Built in coa-service on the R0-ACCOUNTING-SETUP foundation (accounts, periods, sources, sequences all in-process, one DB, one SERIALIZABLE transaction). Inquiry, Trial Balance, financial statements and reporting are NOT in this package.

## Binding decisions

- Tenant is the dealer-group / security boundary only.
- LegalEntity, Store, Franchise and Department are separate models.
- Isolation: shared schema with application-layer tenantId scoping. **PostgreSQL RLS is NOT YET implemented** (see ADR-001 and `docs/accounting-modernization/repository-verification/TENANT_ISOLATION_VERIFICATION.md` — the previous version of this file incorrectly claimed RLS was already delivered; see `docs/accounting-modernization/stabilization/TENANT_ISOLATION_REPORT.md` for current status).
- AuditPort/AuthzPort stubs permitted; stories using them are at most DONE_PENDING_INTEGRATION, never DONE.
